applies_why: The judge text evaluates the defender’s cited verses by whether any text’s own words state the contrary, which is the verse-by-verse stating-verse test K-C retires when a chain is read together.
quote: but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: ‘the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together’: either the defender’s multiple cited verses are a chain read together so K-C applies, or they are isolated citations so K-C does not apply.
why: The judge text relies on the retired stating-verse test by requiring a text’s own words to state the contrary, rather than weighing the read-together chains by footing.
